title: Liu, Lv et al. 2023 — EEG datasets of stroke patients (motor imagery)
description: EEG motor imagery dataset recorded from 50 acute stroke patients (1-30 days post-stroke) using a wireless portable semi-dry saline EEG system. Patients imagined left- or right-hand grasping during video-guided trials (40 per subject). It is presented as the first open dataset addressing left- and right-handed motor imagery in acute stroke, supporting BCI algorithm development and rehabilitation applications. Raw and preprocessed data and patient clinical characteristics are provided.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz with a ZhenTec NT1 wireless system (29 EEG and 2 EOG channels, semi-dry Ag/AgCl electrodes, CPz reference). Each of 40 trials per subject (20 left, 20 right) lasted 8 s, with an audio instruction, 4 s video-guided hand-grip motor imagery, and a rest period. Preprocessing in EEGLAB included baseline removal and 0.5-40 Hz FIR filtering.
